answer: Require each agent to forge a reputation stake that only accrues slowly, like a lotus opening over many verified interactions, rather than buying instant trust. A newcomer must complete costly, checkable work and maintain good behaviour across epochs; creating a dune of fake identities then costs time and forfeited stake for each one, while a single honest agent pays that cost once. Sybils become uneconomical because scale multiplies the price instead of diluting it.
